title: Technical Support Manager — D365 CE or FNO
description:
**Description**
Company Overview:
  
  
When it comes to IT solution providers, there are a lot of choices. But when it comes to providers with innovative and differentiating end-to-end service offerings, there’s really only one: Zones – First Choice for IT.TM
  
  
Zones is a Global Solution Provider of end-to-end IT solutions with an unmatched supply chain. Positioned to be the IT partner you need, Zones, a Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) in business for over 35 years, specializes in Digital Workplace, Cloud & Data Center, Networking, Security, and Managed/Professional/Staffing services. Operating in more than 120 countries, leveraging a robust portfolio, and utilizing the highest certification levels from key partners, including Microsoft, Apple, Cisco, Lenovo, Adobe, and more, Zones has mastered the science of building digital infrastructures that change the way business does business ensuring whatever they need, they can Consider IT Done. Follow Zones, LLC on Twitter @Zones, and LinkedIn and Facebook.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a committed and hands-on Technical Support Manager to lead our Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (D365 CE or FNO) support function. The successful candidate will manage a team of more than ten support engineers and maintenance staff, work across multiple rotational shifts to ensure round-the-clock coverage, and serve as the first point of escalation for SLA breaches and production outages.
  
  
This role combines deep functional expertise in D365 CE and sales processes (Order-to-Cash) with strong people leadership, process governance, and a continuous-improvement mindset. The Technical Support Manager will also oversee 2 to 5 short-term initiatives (1 to 6 months in duration) focused on bug fixes, technical-debt reduction, and incremental enhancements.
  
  
What you’ll do as the Technical Support Manager — D365 CE or FNO :
  
  
Support Operations and SLA Management
  
  

* Operate the D365 CE support function and ensure all support tickets are resolved within agreed SLAs.
* Act as the first point of escalation for SLA breaches, P1/P2 incidents, and production outages.
* Govern the support playbook; continuously improve processes through automation and root-cause prevention.
* Perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on critical issues and drive permanent fixes.
* Define, track, and report on key support metrics and KPIs (MTTR, first-response time, ticket aging, CSAT).

Team and Project Management
  
  

* Lead and mentor a team of 10+ support engineers and maintenance staff across multiple shifts.
* Manage 2 to 5 short-term projects (1 to 6 months) covering bug fixes, technical debt, and minor enhancements.
* Run scrum ceremonies — sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives — and deliver high-quality fixes on schedule.
* Conduct performance reviews, capacity planning, and skills development for the team.

Quality and Knowledge Management
  
  

* Ensure quality checks on knowledge-base articles and ticket-closure documentation.
* Develop new runbooks and update existing ones based on incident learnings and data-driven decisions.
* Promote a culture of documentation, peer review, and continuous learning within the team.

D365 CE and Sales Process (Must Have)
  
  

* D365 CE: Hands-on experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (D365 CE) as an end-user, support engineer, or developer.
* Sales Process: Strong understanding of the sales process — Sales Orders, Pricing, Quotes, Opportunities, and Accounts.
* O2C / P2P: Proficiency in Order-to-Cash (O2C) and/or Procure-to-Pay (P2P) flows, with depth in one or more of: Sales Order, Pricing, Finance O2C, P2P, Tax.
* Modules: Good to moderate proficiency across D365 CE modules with the ability to navigate, troubleshoot, and configure as needed.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Intermediate to advanced SQL — writing queries, analyzing data, and supporting incident investigation.
* Strong troubleshooting skills with attention to detail and the ability to apply learnings across issues.
* Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Azure Monitor, Application Insights).

Leadership and Soft Skills
  
  

* Proven ability to manage and motivate teams across multiple geographies and time zones.
* Excellent oral and written communication; able to brief executives and engage with business stakeholders.
* Fast learner with strong problem-solving instincts and a bias for action.
* Calm under pressure during outages and high-severity incidents.

**What You Will Bring To The Team**

* 12+ years of overall IT experience, 5+ years of hands-on D365 CE or FNO experience (end-user, support, or developer role).
* 5+ years managing teams of 10 or more members, with proven team-building track record.
* Demonstrated experience supporting users and systems across multiple geographies.

Zones offers a comprehensive Benefits package.
  
  
While we’re committed to providing top-tier solutions, we’re just as committed to supporting our own teams. We offer a competitive compensation package where our team members are rewarded based on their performance and recognized for the value they bring into our business. Our team members enjoy a variety of comprehensive benefits, including Medical Insurance Coverage, Group Term Life and Personal Accident Cover to handle the uncertainties of life, flexible leave policy to balance their work life.
  
  
At Zones, work is more than a job – it's an exciting career immersed in an inventive, collaborative culture. If you’re interested in working on the cutting edge of IT innovation, sales, engineering, operations, administration, and more, Zones is the place for you!

title: Senior Executive / Assistant Manager_Student Welfare
description:
Role Purpose

The Student Welfare Officer is responsible for advancing student well-being, safety, engagement, and holistic development. This role serves as a crucial pillar in cultivating a supportive, inclusive campus culture by addressing student needs, delivering welfare programs, and collaborating with academic, administrative, residential, medical, counselling, and disciplinary teams to ensure multi-layered support.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Student Support & Welfare**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for students navigating personal, academic, social, or campus-life challenges.
* Provide active listening and facilitate appropriate support, guidance, and issue resolution.
* Proactively identify students requiring intervention and coordinate support across appropriate departments.
* Uphold strict confidentiality and professional ethics while handling sensitive student matters.

**2. Student Engagement & Development**

* Design and execute initiatives focused on mental well-being, belonging, leadership, life skills, and holistic growth.
* Support and guide student clubs, committees, peer-mentorship programs, and student-led activities.
* Foster an inclusive environment that encourages active participation, peer interaction, and community building.
* Lead the coordination of student orientation, induction programs, awareness campaigns, and welfare events.

**3. Grievance & Conflict Resolution**

* Receive, log, and maintain records of student grievances and formal concerns.
* Coordinate with campus authorities to ensure timely and fair resolution of issues.
* Facilitate mediation and constructive problem-solving for interpersonal conflicts among students.

**4. Student Safety & Safeguarding**

* Partner with hostel, security, medical, administrative, and academic units to maintain campus safety standards.
* Assist in managing student emergencies, safety incidents, and urgent welfare matters.

**5. Hostel & Residential Welfare**

* Liaise effectively between students, hostel wardens, administrative staff, and parents/guardians when necessary.
* Contribute to building a positive, respectful, and supportive residential community.

**6. Mentorship & Peer Support**

* Oversee and manage student mentor/mentee and buddy frameworks.
* Track program participation, evaluate engagement, and ensure regular follow-ups and reporting.

**7. Health & Well-being Initiatives**

* Organize wellness activities and campaigns centered on physical, emotional, and social health.
* Cultivate a stigma-free campus environment where students feel comfortable seeking help.

**8. Student Conduct & Discipline**

* Drive awareness and understanding of the institutional student code of conduct.
* Emphasize educational, preventive, and corrective approaches to discipline rather than purely punitive measures.

**9. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain detailed, confidential records of student cases, interventions, events, and outcomes.
* Prepare comprehensive periodic reports on student welfare trends, activities, and emerging issues.
* Track ongoing cases to ensure timely resolution, required follow-up, or appropriate escalation.
* Adhere strictly to institutional data protection and confidentiality standards.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Exceptional interpersonal and empathetic communication skills
* Active listening, emotional intelligence, and professional maturity
* Strong conflict resolution, mediation, and problem-solving capabilities
* Proven ability to manage sensitive, confidential information with discretion
* Calm decision-making and crisis-management abilities in high-pressure situations
* Dedicated student-centric mindset
* Excellent documentation, case tracking, and reporting skills
* Demonstrated success in organizing events, programs, and community initiatives
* Sound knowledge of student development, safeguarding practices, and institutional policies

**Educational Qualification & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Psychology, Social Work, Education, Student Affairs, Human Resources, Management, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in student affairs, student welfare, counselling coordination, residential life administration, or educational management.
* Direct experience within a higher education institution, residential campus, school, or university environment is preferred.

description:
**Job Description: CRM Manager** 




  





**Job Description:** 




  





 A CRM Specialist plays a crucial role within an organization’s marketing, sales, and
 



 customer service teams by managing workflows and ensuring that customer relationships
 



 are effectively maintained and enhanced through the use of Customer Relationship
 



 Management (CRM) software. By leveraging technology and data, a CRM Specialist works
 



 to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of customer\-facing activities, ultimately
 



 contributing to better customer experience and increased customer loyalty.
 



  





 Rooted within the framework of customer\-centric strategies, CRM Specialists are essential
 



 in various industries where managing customer data, understanding customer behavior,
 



 and automating outreach campaigns are critical for business success. These professionals
 



 work at the intersection of technology and customer relations, synthesizing data insights to
 



 drive business decisions and strategic planning.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





 The main responsibilities of a CRM Specialist encompass a blend of technical, analytical,
 



 and interpersonal skills. Here are the core tasks typically associated with this role:
 



 CRM System Management: Maintain and update CRM systems, ensuring that all customer
 



 information is accurate, complete, and up\-to\-date.
 



 Data Analysis and Reporting: Analyze customer data to identify trends, behaviors, and
 



 opportunities for targeted marketing campaigns or enhanced customer service strategies.
 



 Generate reports to present findings to stakeholders.
 



 Campaign Management: Develop, execute, and monitor marketing campaigns within the
 



 CRM system, including email marketing, lead nurturing, and customer onboarding
 



 campaigns.
 



 Customer Segmentation: Create and manage customer segments based on behavioral,
 



 demographic, and transactional data to personalize communication and marketing efforts.
 



  





 Process Improvement: Identify and implement improvements to customer relationship
 



 processes, enhancing operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
 



 System Integration: Ensure the CRM integrates seamlessly with other systems such as
 



 marketing automation tools, sales platforms, and customer service software.
 



 User Training and Support: Provide training and ongoing support to team members using
 



 the CRM system, ensuring they understand how to effectively leverage its tools and
 



 capabilities.
 



 Customer Feedback Management: Collect and analyze customer feedback, using insights
 



 to make recommendations for service improvements and product enhancements.
 



 Compliance and Data Security: Ensure customer data is handled in compliance with
 



 relevant regulations and company policies, including GDPR and other data protection laws.
 



  





**Required skills** 




  





 A successful CRM Specialist needs a diverse set of skills, blending technical proficiency
 



 with analytical and interpersonal abilities. Key skills include:
 



  





 Technical Proficiency: Understanding of CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho
 



 CRM) and proficiency in using these tools to manage customer data and workflows.
 



  





 • Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze large datasets to extract actionable insights and
 



 trends. Proficiency in using data analysis tools and techniques is crucial.
 



 • Attention to Detail: Ensuring the accuracy and completeness of customer data, as
 



 well as monitoring the effectiveness of campaigns and processes.
 



 • Problem\-Solving Abilities: Identifying issues within CRM processes and systems,
 



 and developing effective solutions to address them.
 



 • Excellent Communication Skills: Ability to communicate findings and recommendations clearly to various stakeholders, including technical and non\-
 



 technical team members.
 



 • Project Management: Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage
 



 multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely completion and implementation.
 



 • Customer\-Centric Mindset: Understanding customer needs and behaviors to
 



 enhance customer engagement and satisfaction.
 



 • Interpersonal Skills: Ability to work collaboratively within teams, provide training,
 



 and support to CRM users across the organization.
 



 • Adaptability: Staying informed about the latest CRM technologies and industry best
 



 practices to continuously improve processes and tools.
 



  





**Tools and technologies** 




  





 CRM Specialists should be proficient in a variety of tools and technologies to
 



 effectively manage customer relationships and data. Essential tools and
 



 technologies include:
 



  





 • CRM Platforms: Familiarity with major CRM systems like Salesforce, Microsoft
 



 Dynamics 365, HubSpot, Zoho CRM, and Pipedrive.
 



 • Marketing Automation Tools: Experience with tools such as Marketo, Pardot,
 



 Mailchimp, and ActiveCampaign to automate marketing campaigns.
 



 • Data Analysis Tools: Proficiency in using data analysis software like Google
 



 Analytics, Tableau, Power BI, and Excel for data reporting and visualization.
 



 • Email Marketing Software: Knowledge of tools like Mailchimp, SendGrid, and
 



 Constant Contact for managing email marketing campaigns.
 



 • Customer Feedback Tools: Experience with platforms like SurveyMonkey,
 



 Qualtrics, and Zendesk for collecting and analyzing customer feedback.
 



 • Integration Platforms: Understanding of tools like Zapier and MuleSoft that
 



 facilitate the seamless integration of CRM systems with other business tools.
 



 • Communication Tools: Proficiency in using communication and collaboration tools
 



 like Slack, Microsoft Teams, and Zoom for effective team coordination and training.
 



 • Project Management Software: Familiarity with tools like Asana, Trello, and
 



 Monday.com to manage and track CRM\-related projects.
